name: comp-409
title: Avatar Group Overflow
description: A row of four circular portraits overlapping with dark rims, finished by a round grey button reading +3 for the people left out.
use: Showing a handful of people on a project or thread when the full list runs longer.
avoid: When every person must be reachable: the +3 control has no click action to reveal the rest.
a11y: Portraits carry alt text, but the +3 button's label does not tell screen readers what the count stands for. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Four square portraits cropped to circles about 40px across overlap by a quarter of their width, each ringed in dark so the edges read. They end in a slightly larger charcoal circle holding a muted +3 that brightens to white on hover.
behaves: Hovering the +3 circle lifts its text from grey to near white while the faces stay still; nothing opens or moves. The rest is static.
customise: Portrait sources, their alt text and the +3 label are fixed in the file; showing real people means editing the image list and the button text.
weight: light: Four small images and one button; no script, no animation loop.
demo: Four stock portraits of women and the label +3.
issues: The +3 button has no click handler, so it hints at more people but opens nothing.
polishWhy: Even overlap and spacing, but the +3 control is a plain grey circle that leads nowhere.
